The Broadway revival of 'Elf The Musical' is a sugar-rush of holiday cheer that delivers exactly what audiences expect from this beloved Christmas story.
The show itself also has lots of syrup, but that sweetness is smartly undercut by knowing humor (for all the adults in the audience).
The material can be hit or miss, but Elf The Musical is a sweet holiday escape.
